rationale: The plan correctly matches the design: DESeq2 Wald on raw counts for 6 vs 6 unpaired single-batch mice, with sample_01 retained in the primary fit and an explicit drop-one sensitivity analysis, plus library size, detection, and PCA/correlation QC that flags the shallow sample. It uses the mouse-native MSigDB Hallmark collection and fgsea preranked on the full list ranked by Wald statistic, avoiding the human-set-on-mouse-symbols error, but names no collection version and no set size window. Weaknesses are the absence of any fold change shrinkage (apeglm), no explicit design formula or reference level, only a passing mention of independent filtering with no stated low-count prefilter, normalization left implicit rather than stated as size factors, and no package versions in the report.
